ingredients.name: pike or sandacz weighing at least eight to ten pounds

steps: Use a pike or sandacz weighing no less than eight to ten pounds.
Clean the fish and carefully split it through the belly with a sharp knife.
Carefully remove the backbone without damaging the skin.

For a ten-pound fish, take one and one-half to two pounds of oil.
Beat two egg yolks in a bowl, mix them well.
Add salt and a pinch of white pepper.

When half a pound of oil has been incorporated, add another beaten egg yolk, a few spoons of oil, and then a fourth egg yolk.
Continue stirring and pouring the oil in drops until all is used.

When the mayonnaise is thick, add strong vinegar to taste and stir in one teaspoon of fine sugar.
